/**
 * Lahn currency conversion tooltips.
 *
 * Finds every {{lahn}} symbol in article content, reads the amount that follows
 * it, and shows a hover popup converting that amount into the major currencies.
 * Requires no changes to any article or template.
 *
 * To change the rates, edit RATES below. Values are units of each currency
 * per 1 lahn. USD is an out-of-universe reader aid and is ruled off from the
 * canon currencies in the popup.
 */
( function () {
	'use strict';

	var RATES = {
		USD: { name: 'US dollar', per: 0.155, sym: '$', real: true },
		EIS: { name: 'Emaran Islatan', per: 0.19 },
		RKA: { name: 'Raledrian Kasare', per: 0.36 },
		AAR: { name: 'Arten Araik', per: 4.20 },
		POR: { name: 'Pelugrotoan Oran', per: 7.75 },
		EZD: { name: 'Estijan Zundetra', per: 61.0 }
	};

	var SCALES = { million: 1e6, billion: 1e9, trillion: 1e12, quadrillion: 1e15 };

	// A bare number, then optionally a scale word. \s covers the &nbsp; in
	// {{lahn}}1.98&nbsp;billion.
	var NUM_RE = /^([0-9][0-9,]*(?:\.[0-9]+)?)(\s*(?:million|billion|trillion|quadrillion))?/i;

	// "8,579 trillion" is a decimal-point typo, not eight thousand trillion.
	// Skip these rather than show a figure a thousand times too large.
	var TYPO_RE = /^[0-9]{1,3},[0-9]{3}$/;

	// Built from the same design tokens as the rest of the wiki
	// ([[MediaWiki:Timeless.css]], section 1) rather than restating the
	// palette, so it follows the site if the palette ever moves again. Every
	// var() carries the day value as a fallback, because Common.js runs under
	// every skin while the tokens are only defined for Timeless.
	//
	// The shape is the infobox's: a title band, the rows, a footer band, each
	// bleeding to the card's edge. So the card itself carries no padding --
	// the three parts carry their own -- and clips to its own radius, which is
	// what squares the bands off against the border.
	//
	// NIGHT MODE is now free, and this is the part worth keeping. Night here
	// is the DarkMode extension putting filter: invert(1) hue-rotate(180deg)
	// on <html>, so a colour written in this file is eaten by the filter
	// rather than displayed: the original background-color:#101418 inverted
	// straight back to white, which is why the popup used to appear as a white
	// card on a dark page. The tokens are already authored pre-inverse, so
	// reading them through var() lands on the right night colour with no
	// second set of rules and no arithmetic -- the whole
	// html.skin-theme-clientpref-night block this replaced is simply gone.
	//
	// --a-raised exists for exactly this: a panel floating above another panel
	// has to sit a step lighter than --a-surface at night or it reads as a
	// hole. In day the border and shadow do that on their own. The shadow
	// inverts to a soft light halo, which still reads as elevation, so it is
	// left as it is.
	var CSS = [
		'.lahn-cvt{border-bottom:1px dotted;cursor:help}',

		'#lahn-cvt-pop{position:fixed;z-index:500;display:none;overflow:hidden;',
		'max-width:26em;padding:0;pointer-events:none;',
		'font-size:0.88rem;line-height:1.5;',
		'background:var(--a-raised,#fff);color:var(--a-text,#202122);',
		'border:1px solid var(--a-border-firm,#c8ccd1);',
		'border-radius:var(--a-radius,2px);',
		'box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.12)}',

		'.lahn-cvt-src{margin:0;padding:0.45em 0.9em;',
		'background:var(--a-thead,#eaecf0);',
		'border-bottom:1px solid var(--a-border-firm,#c8ccd1);',
		'font-weight:bold;text-align:center;white-space:nowrap}',

		'#lahn-cvt-pop table{width:100%;margin:0.4em 0;',
		'border-collapse:collapse;background:transparent}',
		'#lahn-cvt-pop td{padding:0.16em 0.9em;border:0}',
		'.lahn-cvt-c{padding-right:1.5em;white-space:nowrap}',
		'.lahn-cvt-code{color:var(--a-text-dim,#54595d)}',
		'.lahn-cvt-v{text-align:right;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;',
		'white-space:nowrap}',

		'.lahn-cvt-real td{padding-bottom:0.4em;',
		'border-bottom:1px solid var(--a-border,#dfe3e8)}',
		'.lahn-cvt-real+tr td{padding-top:0.4em}',

		'.lahn-cvt-foot{margin:0;padding:0.4em 0.9em;',
		'background:var(--a-sunk,#f8f9fa);',
		'border-top:1px solid var(--a-border,#dfe3e8);',
		'color:var(--a-text-dim,#54595d);font-size:92%;font-style:italic}'
	].join( '' );

	function parseAmount( text ) {
		var m = NUM_RE.exec( text );
		if ( !m ) {
			return null;
		}
		if ( m[ 2 ] && TYPO_RE.test( m[ 1 ] ) ) {
			return null;
		}
		var n = parseFloat( m[ 1 ].replace( /,/g, '' ) );
		if ( !isFinite( n ) ) {
			return null;
		}
		var scale = m[ 2 ] ? SCALES[ m[ 2 ].trim().toLowerCase() ] : 1;
		return { raw: m[ 0 ], value: n * scale };
	}

	function fmt( n ) {
		var u;
		if ( n >= 1e15 ) { u = [ n / 1e15, ' quadrillion' ]; }
		else if ( n >= 1e12 ) { u = [ n / 1e12, ' trillion' ]; }
		else if ( n >= 1e9 ) { u = [ n / 1e9, ' billion' ]; }
		else if ( n >= 1e6 ) { u = [ n / 1e6, ' million' ]; }
		else { return Math.round( n ).toLocaleString( 'en-GB' ); }
		return u[ 0 ].toFixed( 3 ).replace( /\.?0+$/, '' ) + u[ 1 ];
	}

	/**
	 * {{lahn}} renders as
	 *   <span typeof="mw:File"><span title="Lahn"><img alt="Lahn"></span></span>
	 * so the amount is a sibling of the OUTER span, not of the image itself.
	 */
	function amountNodeAfter( img ) {
		var node = img,
			hops = 0;
		while ( !node.nextSibling && node.parentNode && hops < 4 ) {
			if ( node.parentNode.nodeName !== 'SPAN' && node.parentNode.nodeName !== 'A' ) {
				return null;
			}
			node = node.parentNode;
			hops++;
		}
		var next = node.nextSibling;
		return ( next && next.nodeType === 3 ) ? next : null;
	}

	function enhance( root ) {
		if ( !root || !root.querySelectorAll ) {
			return;
		}
		var imgs = root.querySelectorAll( 'img[alt="Lahn"]' );
		Array.prototype.forEach.call( imgs, function ( img ) {
			var textNode = amountNodeAfter( img );
			if ( !textNode ) {
				return;
			}
			var amount = parseAmount( textNode.nodeValue );
			if ( !amount ) {
				return;
			}
			var tail = textNode.splitText( amount.raw.length ),
				span = document.createElement( 'span' );
			span.className = 'lahn-cvt';
			span.setAttribute( 'data-lahn', amount.value );
			span.appendChild( document.createTextNode( amount.raw ) );
			textNode.parentNode.replaceChild( span, textNode );
			span.parentNode.insertBefore( tail, span.nextSibling );
		} );
	}

	function buildPopup( lahn ) {
		var rows = '';
		Object.keys( RATES ).forEach( function ( code ) {
			var r = RATES[ code ];
			rows += '<tr' + ( r.real ? ' class="lahn-cvt-real"' : '' ) + '>' +
				'<td class="lahn-cvt-c">' + r.name +
				' <span class="lahn-cvt-code">(' + code + ')</span></td>' +
				'<td class="lahn-cvt-v">' + ( r.sym || '' ) +
				fmt( lahn * r.per ) + '</td></tr>';
		} );
		return '<div class="lahn-cvt-src">' + fmt( lahn ) + ' lahn</div>' +
			'<table>' + rows + '</table>' +
			'<div class="lahn-cvt-foot">GTU reference rates, 1765</div>';
	}

	var pop = null;

	function popEl() {
		if ( !pop ) {
			pop = document.createElement( 'div' );
			pop.id = 'lahn-cvt-pop';
			document.body.appendChild( pop );
		}
		return pop;
	}

	function place( el, e ) {
		var pad = 12,
			x = e.clientX + pad,
			y = e.clientY + pad;
		if ( x + el.offsetWidth > window.innerWidth - 8 ) {
			x = e.clientX - el.offsetWidth - pad;
		}
		if ( y + el.offsetHeight > window.innerHeight - 8 ) {
			y = e.clientY - el.offsetHeight - pad;
		}
		el.style.left = Math.max( 8, x ) + 'px';
		el.style.top = Math.max( 8, y ) + 'px';
	}

	function target( e ) {
		return ( e.target && e.target.closest ) ? e.target.closest( '.lahn-cvt' ) : null;
	}

	document.addEventListener( 'mouseover', function ( e ) {
		var t = target( e );
		if ( !t ) {
			return;
		}
		var el = popEl();
		el.innerHTML = buildPopup( parseFloat( t.getAttribute( 'data-lahn' ) ) );
		el.style.display = 'block';
		place( el, e );
	} );

	document.addEventListener( 'mousemove', function ( e ) {
		if ( pop && pop.style.display === 'block' && target( e ) ) {
			place( pop, e );
		}
	} );

	document.addEventListener( 'mouseout', function ( e ) {
		if ( pop && target( e ) ) {
			pop.style.display = 'none';
		}
	} );

	mw.loader.using( 'mediawiki.util' ).then( function () {
		mw.util.addCSS( CSS );
		// wikipage.content has usually already fired by the time this module
		// runs, and does not replay for late subscribers here, so sweep the
		// rendered page directly first.
		enhance( document.getElementById( 'mw-content-text' ) || document.body );
		// Then keep listening, for live preview and lazily loaded content.
		// Re-running is harmless: an already-wrapped amount is an element node,
		// not a text node, so it is skipped.
		mw.hook( 'wikipage.content' ).add( function ( $content ) {
			enhance( $content[ 0 ] );
		} );
	} );
}() );
/**
 * Switchable images ({{Switcher}}).
 *
 * Module:Switcher only emits markup: a .switcher-container holding one div per
 * image, each ending in a hidden span.switcher-label caption. All the actual
 * behaviour lives in MediaWiki:Gadget-switcher.js on Wikipedia, which this wiki
 * does not have, so the images just stacked on top of each other. This is that
 * gadget, inlined here so it works for logged-out readers with no preference
 * to tick.
 *
 * The initially shown option is the one whose label span carries
 * data-switcher-default (Module:Switcher sets it from |default=N). An option
 * whose label is empty comes from an unpaired parameter and is dropped, since
 * there is no caption to put on a radio button for it.
 */
( function () {
	'use strict';

	var CSS = [
		'.switcher-controls {',
			'margin: 0.4em 0 0;',
			'font-size: 88%;',
			'line-height: 1.4;',
			'text-align: center;',
		'}',
		'.switcher-controls label {',
			'display: inline-block;',
			'margin: 0 0.6em 0.2em 0;',
			'cursor: pointer;',
			'white-space: normal;',
		'}',
		'.switcher-controls label:last-child { margin-right: 0; }',
		'.switcher-controls input {',
			'margin: 0 0.3em 0 0;',
			'vertical-align: middle;',
		'}'
	].join( '' );

	var seq = 0;

	function trim( s ) {
		return s.replace( /^\s+|\s+$/g, '' );
	}

	function build( container ) {
		if ( container.className.indexOf( 'switcher-ready' ) !== -1 ) {
			return;
		}

		var panes = [];
		var kids = Array.prototype.slice.call( container.children );

		kids.forEach( function ( node ) {
			var label = node.querySelector ?
				node.querySelector( '.switcher-label' ) : null;
			if ( !label ) {
				return;
			}
			label.style.display = 'none';
			if ( !trim( label.textContent || label.innerText || '' ) ) {
				// Unpaired parameter: content with no caption, so nothing to
				// label a button with. Not selectable, so do not show it.
				node.style.display = 'none';
				return;
			}
			panes.push( {
				node: node,
				html: label.innerHTML,
				isDefault: label.hasAttribute( 'data-switcher-default' )
			} );
		} );

		if ( panes.length < 2 ) {
			return;
		}

		container.className += ' switcher-ready';

		function show( idx ) {
			panes.forEach( function ( pane, j ) {
				pane.node.style.display = ( j === idx ) ? '' : 'none';
			} );
			panes[ idx ].radio.checked = true;
		}

		var name = 'switcher-' + ( ++seq );
		var controls = document.createElement( 'div' );
		controls.className = 'switcher-controls';
		var chosen = 0;

		panes.forEach( function ( pane, idx ) {
			if ( pane.isDefault ) {
				chosen = idx;
			}

			var label = document.createElement( 'label' );
			var radio = document.createElement( 'input' );
			radio.type = 'radio';
			radio.name = name;
			radio.addEventListener( 'change', function () {
				show( idx );
			} );

			var text = document.createElement( 'span' );
			text.innerHTML = pane.html;

			label.appendChild( radio );
			label.appendChild( text );
			controls.appendChild( label );
			pane.radio = radio;
		} );

		container.appendChild( controls );
		show( chosen );
	}

	function enhance( root ) {
		if ( !root || !root.querySelectorAll ) {
			return;
		}
		Array.prototype.forEach.call(
			root.querySelectorAll( '.switcher-container' ), build
		);
	}

	mw.loader.using( 'mediawiki.util' ).then( function () {
		mw.util.addCSS( CSS );
		// wikipage.content has usually already fired by the time this runs and
		// does not replay for late subscribers, so sweep the rendered page
		// first, then keep listening for previews and lazily loaded content.
		enhance( document.getElementById( 'mw-content-text' ) || document.body );
		mw.hook( 'wikipage.content' ).add( function ( $content ) {
			enhance( $content[ 0 ] );
		} );
	} );
}() );
